youtube.title: Why Diogenes brought Plato a plucked chicken 🐔 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Diogenes vs Plato: the greatest troll in the history of philosophy. 🐔

Plato defined man as a "featherless biped". Diogenes showed up with a plucked chicken.

Who won this one, Plato or Diogenes? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Diogenes Laertius: when Plato defined man as a featherless biped, Diogenes plucked a chicken and brought it to the Academy saying "Behold, Plato's man!" Plato then added "with broad flat nails".

#diogenes #plato #philosophy #greekphilosophy #ancientgreece #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
